operationName: Operation Swords of Iron (Israel) / October 7 War
heroHeadline: Netanyahu Accused of Stalling Ceasefire for Elections as Gaza Escalation Continues — Day 957
heroSubtitle: On Day 957 of the Gaza war (May 25, 2026), IDF sniper fire killed Samih Dardouna, 23, in Jabalia refugee camp while he was searching for food to feed his displaced children. The body of 8-year-old Hani Abdullah Shakshak was recovered from a tent in northwest Gaza after overnight Israeli airstrikes. Israeli naval vessels wounded three fishermen off Gaza's coast. Five European nations — Spain, the Netherlands, Belgium, France, and Poland — have now banned National Security Minister Ben-Gvir from their territories over his treatment of detained Global Sumud Flotilla activists, while Italy formally requested EU-wide sanctions. Eight Arab and Islamic nations issued a joint condemnation. Gaza faces a flour crisis with only 200 of 450 required tonnes per day reaching the territory, and medicine stocks are critically low across all hospitals.
footerNote: Data sourced from IDF, Hamas, UN OCHA, UNRWA, WHO, ICJ, ICC, Times of Israel, Al Jazeera, Haaretz, IMEMC, WAFA, TIME, Pakistan Today, HRW, PressTV, Al Arabiya, Euronews, Washington Post, NBC News, Middle East Eye, OHCHR. Gaza death toll: 73,800+ confirmed killed since Oct 7, 2023. Day 957 (May 25): IDF sniper kills Samih Dardouna (23) in Jabalia searching for food; 8-yr-old Hani Shakshak found dead in NW Gaza; 3 fishermen wounded by naval fire; 5 European nations ban Ben-Gvir (Spain, Netherlands, Belgium, France, Poland); Italy leads EU sanctions push; 8 Arab/Islamic nations condemn Ben-Gvir. Day 956 (May 24): IDF strikes Nuseirat apartment — Abu Mlouh family killed incl. 1-yr-old; police station strike kills 7; UN: only 906 aid truckloads since Rafah op; Flash Appeal 13% funded. Day 955 (May 23): overnight strikes on Nuseirat/Bureij camps; 5 officers killed at northern Gaza police post; France bans Ben-Gvir. Day 954 (May 22): 422 flotilla activists arrive in Turkey; Italy pushes EU sanctions against Ben-Gvir; Netanyahu rebukes Ben-Gvir. Day 949 (May 17): Bahaa Baroud killed. Day 948 (May 16): Hamas military wing chief Haddad killed. Day 945 (May 13): Mohammed Sinwar killed. UNRWA staff killed: 391. IDF security cabinet authorized war resumption May 10, 2026. Orange Line = 64%+ of Gaza Strip.
